title: Thoughts on UI / animation? Please read description
author: because-potato
selftext:
Creating a location based stardew valley mmo - I know the map loops a bit janky, but it is because it is pixel rpg graphics overlaid on real map data. Please also ignore the purple - I crossed out street labels and coordinates and such. 

Entire game will all be on one map and you can build structures, hunt, fish, claim territory, and way way more.

comments.author: romansamurai
comments.body: I’m 100% sure this was already posted a month or two ago, this identical screenshot. What has changed since then?

replies.author: because-potato
replies.body: Ground texture updated, not visible here but player motion updated, trees updated to hopefully be a little less generic, and rendering layers and scale updated on the textures

replies.author: romansamurai
replies.body:
I think if you could make a short video of how it works and plays it would be easier to give some additional feedback.

But as far as what you asked, to me the ui and sprites look good imo.

replies.author: because-potato
replies.body: Thank you for the input - I will work on putting together a limited gameplay trailer!
